subject: CloudWave Health — Onramp MAP & PO activation timeline
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Amir Sayeed <amir@cloudwavehealth.com>, procurement@cloudwavehealth.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-16T09:22:00Z
Subject: CloudWave MAP + AWS private offer kickoff

Hi Amir / CloudWave procurement team,

Following our demo last week — excited to move to a pilot and discuss the purchase path. I wanted to put a very short mutual action plan (MAP) on the table and confirm a few procurement details so we can align timelines for an AWS Private Offer. High level asks: 

- Do you have a preferred invoicing entity and billing cadence (monthly/quarterly)?
- Primary legal / contracting contact for SOW and PO routing?
- Any internal acceptance criteria we should bake into the MAP?

Proposed timeline (can compress if needed):
1) 1 week — finalize MAP + SOW and procurement checklist
2) 2 weeks — AWS Private Offer creation and legal review
3) 1 week — customer sign + PO issuance
4) Target activation: ~2025-09-30 (pilot to start)

Attached: draft one-pager MAP to iterate. Jordan (me) will own coordination; Neha and Aditya will be primary ops/solutions points on Redwood side.

Thanks — let me know who on your side should own each procurement step and whether the proposed activation date is realistic.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Amir Sayeed <amir@cloudwavehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudwavehealth.com, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-17T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: CloudWave MAP + AWS private offer kickoff

Jordan — thanks for the clear plan. A few items from procurement/legal we need to confirm before we can commit to the timeline: 

1) Invoicing entity: CloudWave Health, Inc. (US legal entity) — will need W-9 / tax id on vendor invoice.
2) PO process: Our procurement team needs an SOW and a signed order form to raise a PO. Lead time is typically 10 business days once we have those documents.
3) Term & billing cadence: Prefer quarterly invoicing for pilots >$25k; monthly if under that threshold.
4) Data residency: pilot traffic will be routed through EU region; are there any additional controls for private deployments?
5) Contract redlines: we track insurance and liability caps tightly — legal will send a redline set.

Attaching an account packet with our procurement intake form for your finance team to fill (CloudWave_Acct_Info.pdf).

If you can send a MAP with concrete dates and a draft SOW, I can get internal owners assigned this week. Target activation looks reasonable if we can get SOW signed by 2025-09-01.

—Amir
Amir Sayeed
Director, Procurement | CloudWave Health
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Amir Sayeed <amir@cloudwavehealth.com>, procurement@cloudwavehealth.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-18T08:40:00Z
Subject: CloudWave MAP (draft) + SOW and billing path options

Hi Amir / CloudWave procurement,

Thanks for the procurement packet and clarity on cadence. Attached are two items for review: a draft MAP (MAP_CloudWave_v2.xlsx) and a draft SOW (Redwood_SaaS_SOW_v1.pdf). Key points captured in the MAP:

- Acceptance gates: test plan (functional smoke tests), security review sign-off, billing & PO confirmed.
- Timeline:
  • 2025-08-18 — MAP + SOW shared (this email)
  • 2025-08-25 — Legal review complete (CloudWave legal owners assigned)
  • 2025-08-28 — AWS Private Offer created & Redemptions validated
  • 2025-09-04 — Customer sign & PO issued
  • 2025-09-11 — Private Offer invoicing enabled, pilot onboarding starts

- Billing path options (please confirm preferred):
  1) AWS Private Offer: Redwood issues invoices to CloudWave per agreed cadence; purchase is an AWS Private Offer / marketplace flow but invoiced by Redwood — recommended for predictable accounting and to keep usage attribution in AWS billing.
  2) Marketplace Commitment: CloudWave commits spend directly in AWS Marketplace; invoicing handled by AWS — may be preferred if your finance needs AWS consolidated billing.

Please confirm: invoicing entity (you indicated CloudWave Health, Inc.), whether quarterly cadence is acceptable if pilot exceeds $25k, and legal contact for redlines. 

Next asks from Redwood:
- Aditya will share a short note on how the AWS private offer invoice will appear (line items + TIN info).
- Jordan will coordinate DocuSign routing for the SOW.

If you want to accelerate, we can compress legal review by sharing a tracked SOW and standing up a short meeting with your legal owner.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Lead Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_CloudWave_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), Redwood_SaaS_SOW_v1.pdf (document stub)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-19T14:12:00Z
Subject: Re: CloudWave MAP — billing path question (internal)

Aditya — quick internal note before we finalize the MAP: 

- CloudWave prefers quarterly if pilot >$25k. If we propose AWS Private Offer invoicing by Redwood, we need a short cover note that spells out: Redwood legal name, Redwood tax id, invoice frequency options, and how usage/overages will be billed. Can you draft that (1 page) by EOD 8/20?
- Also confirm whether we can include a 60-day payment term (their procurement tends to push for 60). If finance pushes back, propose 45 days as a compromise and mark it as negotiable on the MAP.
- For EU residency: confirm that the private offer can target eu-west-1 and that our standard data-processing addendum covers pilot telemetry. If not, we need an addendum to the SOW.

Thanks — cc'ing Jordan for visibility.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Lead Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Amir Sayeed <amir@cloudwavehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudwavehealth.com
Date: 2025-08-22T16:35:00Z
Subject: Re: CloudWave MAP (draft) + SOW and billing path options

Neha / Jordan — this is great, thanks. We reviewed the MAP and SOW with our procurement and legal leads; next steps: 

- We prefer the AWS Private Offer route (option 1) and quarterly invoicing for the pilot.
- Legal will send a redline to the SOW today; please expect comments on insurance and liability sections.
- Our point-of-contact for contracts is: Maria Klein <maria.klein@cloudwavehealth.com> (copied to procurement alias).
- Target: SOW signed and PO issued by 2025-09-04. If that holds, onboarding can start the week of 2025-09-11.

Attached: Signed_SOW_CloudWave.pdf (stub of executed signature page) — we signed the signature page pending your DocuSign envelope for final execution. Please send the DocuSign link and invoice preview (sample line items) and we'll route the PO.

—Amir
Amir Sayeed
Director, Procurement | CloudWave Health
